common_guards.rule: Only trusted MuJoCo joint state may support success; command receipts and self-report are not evidence.
NaN, infinity, missing state, or unavailable measurement fails the trial.
Use only the declared official Menagerie left-hand scene reference.

definitions.continuous_dwell: Every terminal check holds at every required harness sample.
definitions.experimental_threshold: The numerical value is a draft starting point and has not been physically calibrated.

criteria.criterion_text: All 16 joint positions are within 0.15 rad of the supplied neutral posture for 1.0 s.
The four index-finger joint positions are within 0.15 rad of the supplied flexion posture for 1.0 s.
The eight middle/ring joint pairs differ by at most 0.15 rad in aggregate for 1.0 s.
The four thumb joint positions are within 0.15 rad of the supplied opposition posture for 1.0 s.
After the bounded motion, all 12 finger/thumb joints are within 0.20 rad of the supplied pre-grasp posture.
